summary: cli_parse with ansible.utils.json converts JSON CLI output such as show interface | json, mostly for playbook consistency since Ansible already converts JSON.
questions: How do I parse JSON output from a network command?
Do I need cli_parse for JSON output?

answer_card.title: Parse JSON output
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    command: show interface | json
    parser:
      name: ansible.utils.json
  register: interfaces
```
Ansible usually converts JSON automatically; this exists mainly for playbook consistency.
